title: akuko project
description: akuko.json project format, schema_version 1. Generated from akuko-project.ts; do not edit by hand.

source.description: Credit line for the source work, e.g. an adaptation note.

fps.description: Timeline frame rate. Absent: chosen at export (--fps, default 24).

content.description: Text output of the stage (e.g. a beat-sheet entry).

output.description: File the stage produced for this unit (panel, frame, clip).

decision.description: Id of the Decision this comment was folded from, so an undo can find it.

camera.description: Free-text camera note, e.g. "Static, low angle".

refs.description: Bible entry ids or asset ids this shot must stay consistent with.

script_line.description: The screenplay or story text this shot covers.

narration.description: Voice-over / narration text spoken over the shot.

intent.description: Why the shot exists; treatment note.

source.description: The sheet row this shot was imported from (WP-25).

film.description: Where the shot sits on the master clock (audio.master), in seconds.

part.description: Part of the film the shot belongs to, e.g. "P7".

lighting.description: Lighting code from the sheet; the phrase it stands for is in the bible.

framing.description: Framing from the sheet, free text.

motion_note.description: Motion note from the sheet, free text (e.g. "Slow push-in").

lines.description: Dialogue lines the shot covers (audio.lines ids).

move.description: Camera move on the still (treatment still-move).

owner.description: Bible entry or shot this asset belongs to.

provider.description: Provider that generated it, when generated.

film.description: Where the asset sits on the master clock, in seconds. Required on a card (integrity).

part.description: Part of the film the scene belongs to, e.g. "P7".

source.description: The sheet scene this scene was imported from (WP-25).

units.description: Units the job produces output for.

approved_max.description: Most the person allowed this job to cost, if it may run over the estimate.

decision.description: Id of the Decision that approved or declined the job.

id.description: Stable id for one provider call, so an entry can be followed from submitted to done or failed across retries.

unit.description: Unit the call produced output for.

job.description: pending_spend id the call ran under.

unit.description: Shot, bible entry, asset or job id.

by.description: Viewer identity when the host knows it, else "you".

renders.description: Studio render records. These stay open to unknown keys, as in Studio; their nested file refs are strict.

extra.description: Unknown keys the Studio cell carried (Studio keeps them across version skew).

script.description: Studio script header; null when the Studio project had no script.

extra.description: Unknown keys the Studio project carried.

rung_extra.description: Leftover keys per freeform rung (e.g. tsx_anchor), keyed by rung name.

extra.description: Unknown keys the freeform beat carried.
Top-level keys of the freeform storyboard that were not mapped.

row.description: 1-based spreadsheet row, for the person to find it again.

start_tc.description: Timecode of the first sample, e.g. "00:00:00:00".

sha256.description: Digest of the file, to notice a changed master.

character.description: Who speaks or thinks it (a name, or a bible character id).

text.description: The words, as written in the source.

never_from_photo.description: Bible entry ids that may only use generated references, never a photo.

role.description: The signer's role; must be the gate's `needs` (integrity).

via.description: How the sign-off was given, e.g. "email", "in person", "shared page".

host.description: Written by host detection at the start of every action.

source.description: Path of the source story / treatment, relative to the project.

screenplay.description: Path of the Fountain screenplay, relative to the project.

analysis.description: Beat map of the music track (ms).

budget.description: null until setup sets a cap; the spend gate refuses paid jobs without one.

rules.description: Hard project rules. Absent = none (read through rulesOf()).

people.description: Who approves (approver) and who signs gates (signoff).

gates.description: Milestones only a signoff person passes.
